title: Wardrobe cosmetic types
description: Two-level list of make-up product types on the Make-up tab: a group (Lips, Eyes…) and the types inside it, listed after their group.

id.description: Stable id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Saved products refer to it, so it is never renamed or reused once shipped.

parent.description: The group this type belongs to (an entry without a parent). Leave out for a group.

multi.description: Usually holds several shades (a palette): the form opens the photo sampler ready to add one shade per pan.

aliases.description: Other names for this entry. The entry’s own id also matches.
